tools.description: Get ranked ride options from origin to destination within a departure window, each with price, provider, estimated pickup and drop-off, and constraint flags. Read only: nothing is booked or charged.

contract_version.description: Semantic version of the contract. Requests may send a bare major ("1") or a full version; responses always carry the full version the gateway speaks.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code, uppercase, for example USD.

departure_window.description: When the rider wants to be picked up. latest must not be before earliest. An earliest time in the past means as soon as possible.

money.description: An amount in the currency's smallest unit (cents for USD), so 2350 with USD is 23.50 dollars. Never a floating point number.

place.description: A pickup or drop-off point. Give an address, coordinates, or both; when both are present the coordinates win.

label.description: A human name for the place, for example "barber". Shown back to the person; never used for routing.

timestamp.description: A date and time in Request for Comments 3339 form with an explicit offset, for example 2026-10-12T15:00:00-07:00.

user_preferences.description: Soft and hard preferences. Every field is optional.

accessibility_needs.description: Hard requirements. An option that cannot meet one is flagged accessibility_not_met and is not bookable.

avoided_providers.description: Provider names never to offer. A filter: options from these providers are left out entirely.

preferred_providers.description: Provider names, as they appear in the provider field of earlier results, to rank first. A preference, not a filter.

ranking.description: How to order bookable options. balanced puts preferred providers first, then the lowest authorization cap, then the earliest drop-off.

tip_ceiling_percent.description: The most the rider will tip, as a percent of the fare ceiling. Default 20. The tip ceiling counts against budget_ceiling.

vehicle_classes.description: Vehicle classes the rider wants. Others are still offered, flagged vehicle_class_not_requested.

budget_ceiling.description: The most the person will pay in total, tip included. Options whose authorization_cap is above it are flagged over_budget.

tools.name: quote_ride

cancellation_policy.description: free_until: cancelling before this time costs nothing. After it, and until the trip starts, cancelling costs fee_after_free_period. Once the trip starts it cannot be cancelled.

charge_terms.description: What the money layer needs to hold funds for one ride, and nothing about how it pays. quoted_amount is the expected fare, fare_ceiling the most the fare can be, tip_ceiling the most the tip can be, authorization_cap is fare_ceiling plus tip_ceiling and is the hard limit for a per-booking virtual card. All four share one currency.

constraint_flag.description: Why an option might not suit the request. Blocking flags (over_budget, outside_departure_window, accessibility_not_met) make the option unbookable; the rest are advisory.

contract_version.description: Semantic version of the contract. Requests may send a bare major ("1") or a full version; responses always carry the full version the gateway speaks.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code, uppercase, for example USD.

fulfillment.description: How the booking is carried out. automated means software books the ride. human_assisted means a person on the sirven concierge team books it on the rider's behalf; disclosure is then a plain sentence the agent must show the person before they approve the booking.

money.description: An amount in the currency's smallest unit (cents for USD), so 2350 with USD is 23.50 dollars. Never a floating point number.

notice.description: Something the person should know about the quote as a whole, for example that a service refused agent access. Never names the backend.

price.description: fixed means the fare is guaranteed until the quote expires. estimate means the final fare may land anywhere up to maximum, and never above it.

quote_id.description: Identifies one quoted option. Opaque: callers must not parse it, and it never encodes which backend served the ride.

bookable.description: False when any blocking constraint flag is present. book_ride refuses unbookable options.

provider.description: The ride service the rider will see on the car or in the receipt, as a plain display name. A returned attribute, never an input to routing.

rank.description: 1 is the best match. Ranks are dense and start at 1.

timestamp.description: A date and time in Request for Comments 3339 form with an explicit offset, for example 2026-10-12T15:00:00-07:00.

tools.description: Book one option from quote_ride by its quote_id. Ask the person first. Booking the same quote_id again returns the same booking; it never books twice.

contract_version.description: Semantic version of the contract. Requests may send a bare major ("1") or a full version; responses always carry the full version the gateway speaks.

quote_id.description: Identifies one quoted option. Opaque: callers must not parse it, and it never encodes which backend served the ride.

payment_reference.description: An opaque handle from the sirven money layer for the funds held against this booking. Never a card number or any card detail.

tools.name: book_ride

confirm_by.description: For requested bookings: if not confirmed by this time the booking moves to failed and nothing is charged. null once confirmed.

booking_id.description: Identifies one booking. Opaque, like quote_id.

booking_status.description: requested: accepted but not yet confirmed by the ride service (human_assisted bookings sit here until confirmed). confirmed: a ride is promised. driver_assigned: a vehicle is on its way. in_progress: the trip started. completed: the trip ended and final_charge is set. cancelled and failed are terminal.

replayed.description: True when this quote_id was already booked and this is the original booking returned again.
